subject: The secret feature 90% of users never discover
preview_text: One user found it by accident. It changed their entire approach to picking winners. Here's what they did.
body_paragraphs: Got a confession. A user emailed me last week. Said he was about to delete the app. On a brutal losing streak. Then, by total accident, he tapped something most people scroll right past.

He was looking at a racecard for Cheltenham, frustrated. His gut picks kept losing. He accidentally swiped left on a horse's name. A whole new screen opened. Not just speed ratings. It showed the horse's exact performance breakdown by track condition. How it runs on soft vs. firm ground. Its win rate at that exact distance. The AI had buried the ultimate 'horse vs. course' cheat sheet.

That buried feature is the 'Horse Profile Deep Dive'. It's not on the main prediction screen. You have to tap a horse's name on the racecard, then swipe. It shows you the AI's analysis of that horse's specific suitability for TODAY'S race conditions. Not just a generic rating. It's why that horse is graded a 78% match for the wet track at Ascot right now.

Open the app. Pick any race. Tap a horse, then swipe left. See the 'Deep Dive'. That's where the real edge is. P.S. Premium users get this deep dive for EVERY horse in a race, instantly. The 3-day trial lets you test it on the next meet.
